subject: Literature
title: Myth and Video Games
description: Learn Myth and Video Games in one minute.

hook.text: The video game God of War lets players battle Zeus and Thor, making mythology interactive for millions.

buildup.text: Games like Hades, Assassin's Creed, and Okami draw directly from Greek, Norse, and Japanese mythologies.

discovery.text: Hades made the underworld's mythology accessible to a generation that never read the original Greek texts.

twist.text: Some scholars argue games are the oral tradition's true successor: interactive, communal, and endlessly retold.

climax.text: Video games may be the most powerful vehicle for mythological storytelling in the twenty-first century.

punchline.text: Ancient myths found their newest stage inside a console.

quiz.question: Why do some scholars compare video games to oral tradition?
options: Both are interactive, communal, and endlessly retold
Both are only enjoyed by young audiences
